messages:
Rina: Heads up! Our teammate Priya's birthday is Wednesday 4/2. Planning a surprise 4:15pm cake-stand & quick toast in the lounge. Thoughts on a mini playlist? :party_popper:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please mark your attendance with a :raised_hands: reaction by Tue 5pm. Budget tag: `POPS-24`.
Kai: I'll bring a small speaker and whip up a 10-min playlist. Any song requests?
Marcus: Can we keep it chill? some old-school R&B and indie pop. Nothing too loud.
Ava: Happy to curate a "Feel-Good" list. Also can bring sparkling water + reusable cups.
Devon: I'm remote but can send a short video message with a birthday shoutout to Priya.
Rina: Love that, Devon! We'll play the video during the toast. Also preferences: cake or empanadas? (yes I'm suggesting empanadas)
Kai: empanadas would be fun and portable. But cake is the tradition.
Marcus: cake for tradition, empanadas for creativity. Split decision?
Ava: Vote: :cake: for cake, :taco: for empanadas. (emoji stand-in)
people-ops-bot: Poll created 1 reactions so far. Poll ends Tue 5pm.
Rina: Also folks with dietary constraints please DM me. Priya is gluten-free (FYI) so keep GF options in mind.
Marcus: Noted. I'll get a GF-friendly cake slice option from the bakery.
Kai: Playlist suggestions: "September - Earth, Wind & Fire", "Dog Days Are Over - Florence + The Machine"
Devon: sending video now...
people-ops-bot: Video uploaded by Devon (00:35).
Ava: :raised_hands: I'll be there in person and can help set up.
Rina: Thanks! I'll reserve the lounge and set a 3:45pm setup reminder.
Marcus: I'll bring a small cake knife and candles.
Rina: Perfect. Also anyone want to sign a card? I'll leave a physical card on reception desk; remote folks I'll circulate a Doc to add messages.
Kai: I'll sign in person.
Devon: I'll add mine to the Doc.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Wed 3:45pm "Set up for Priya's bday".
Rina: Thanks everyone for the help. Priya's going to be surprised :blush:
